##Two-Space Low Pincer

This pincer became popular after AlphaGo used it to great effect, particularly to support a Kobayashi framework with a black stone around <X:Q10>.

If the ladders after White <A:Q14> then Black <B:R14> are favorable to White, then **A** is the correct move.

[Explanation by Go Inside on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/fawf6DcCQDc?si=B_St5jaKHk2Ifcry&t=653)
